raw:
I found results for all 24 rounds of the 2025 season and checked each race's grid position 1 against the winner. The pole sitter won 16 times.

**Pole sitter won (16):** Australia (Norris), China (Piastri), Japan (Verstappen), Bahrain (Piastri), Monaco (Norris), Spain (Piastri), Canada (Russell), Austria (Norris), Netherlands (Piastri), Italy (Verstappen), Azerbaijan (Verstappen), Singapore (Russell), United States (Verstappen), Mexico (Norris), São Paulo (Norris), Abu Dhabi (Verstappen).

**Pole sitter did not win (8):** Saudi Arabia (Verstappen on pole, Piastri won), Miami (Piastri started 4th), Emilia Romagna (Piastri on pole, Verstappen won from 2nd), Great Britain (Verstappen on pole, Norris won from 3rd), Belgium (Norris on pole, Piastri won from 2nd), Hungary (Leclerc on pole, Norris won from 3rd), Las Vegas (Verstappen started 2nd, Russell... Verstappen won from 2nd), Qatar (Piastri on pole, Verstappen won from 3rd).
